title: Kutukwa kweGoho Guru
intro: Munyika yekare, mumwe mweya wakamira pakati pevapfumi vemunharaunda yavo. Makomborero epasi akasvika kwavari kaviri mumakore akatevedzana, goho rakapetwa kaviri raifanira kunge rakazadza mwoyo yavo nekutenda. Asi apo njodzi yakaitika uye zvese zvavaiva nazvo zvakatorwa muusiku humwe chete, mhinduro yavo yakaratidza hunhu hwechokwadi hwemweya wavo. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena hunhu hwemunhu uyu ane nyaya inoshanda seyambiro pamusoro pekusatenda makomborero aAllah?
clues: Ndakanga ndiri mumwe wevanhu vaiva nerombo rakanaka kwazvo munyika yese, ndakakomborerwa nezvokudya zvakawanda.
Goho rakauya kwandiri kaviri mumakore maviri, asi moyo wangu wakaramba usingaongi Ishe wangu.
Ndaiva nebindu rakanaka rine mizambiringa, maorivhi, nemiti yemichindwe—uchapupu hwenyasha dzaAllah.
Bindu rangu parakaparadzwa, ndakamira mumatongo aro maoko akatambanudzirwa kudenga, ndichituka mugumo wangu.
Ndakaramba kuti Allah angadai akakonzera kurasikirwa kwakadaro, kunyangwe ndakapwanya zvanza zvangu nekuora mwoyo.
Chirango changu chakanga chisiri chekungorasikirwa nebindu rangu chete, asi kusiyiwa ndisina simba zvachose mumatongo aro, ndisingakwanise kukumbira chero mubatsiri.
